verdict.rationale: Veo's docs say it turns text prompts and images into short videos and accept image and video inputs alongside text, so reference-conditioned generation exists. Nothing documents using a reference specifically to carry its style into new footage. One hands-on report says Whisk (with Veo 2) redraws the source image so the result barely resembles it, which undercuts how faithfully references are followed. Missing for 10: documented style-reference or style-transfer control, explicit video-as-style-reference workflow, independent corroboration that outputs match a reference's style.

support.subject: As a creator, I can point at a reference video or image and generate new footage in that style

citations.quote: It excels at quickly turning text prompts and images into short videos
multi-input reasoning (supporting text, images, audio, and video inputs simultaneously), character consistency
